title: Madagascar’s Giant Bats Are Getting Smaller
paragraphs: Scientists at the Field Museum in Chicago say that the Malagasy flying fox is getting smaller. This bat is one of the biggest bats in the world. It lives only in Madagascar.
The team measured 121 bats from nine museums. Some of the bats were collected more than 150 years ago. The skulls of bats from before 1980 were about 6 percent longer than the skulls of newer bats.

The change began when hunting became a business. Before 1980, people usually hunted a few bats for their families. Later, bats were sold in markets and restaurants. The scientists think hunters may choose the biggest bats because they give the most meat.
